requirement:
During report conversion, on a terminal enabled under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.processes.progress.terminal`, Habeas MUST
display updating progress with elapsed time and completed and total
test-attempt counts. The total MUST count the recorded attempts selected for
conversion. An attempt MUST advance the completed count only after its
conversion has finished or reported a collection failure, including processing
its associated child-process profiles. These counts MUST measure conversion
work regardless of the attempt's test outcome.
rationale:
The reviewed tests adequately cover `requirements.test-coverage.processes.progress`. All three carry {test} markers for it. The terminal-enablement policy belongs to `requirements.test-coverage.processes.progress.terminal`, which is cited context, so I did not reassess it.

Obligation-to-test mapping:

1. **Updating progress with elapsed time and completed/total counts, on an enabled terminal.**
   - `src/execution_coverage/progress.rs#mod[tests]/fn[stage_and_conversion_counts_are_visible_then_cleared]` builds a conversion `Progress` with totals 0 and 2. It calls `completed()` and asserts the bar position and the drawn text `N/T attempts`. It also asserts the `[00:00:` elapsed field and that the display is monochrome.
   - `tests/execution_coverage.rs#fn[coverage_progress_on_a_pty_preserves_reports_and_plain_output_policy]` runs the real binary on a pty with TERM=xterm. It asserts `Converting coverage`, `1/1 attempts` and `[00:`.

2. **The total counts the recorded attempts selected for conversion.**
   - The pty test uses a fixture with several tests plus earlier saved runs. Each filtered run must show exactly `1/1 attempts`, so the total is neither all tests nor accumulated earlier attempts.
   - `src/execution_coverage/runner.rs#mod[tests]/fn[parallel_conversion_is_bounded_and_retains_every_result_in_order]` covers larger totals (4 and 16) at the `parallel_collect` level.
   - The selection filter in `finish` has no end-to-end test with more than one selected attempt. I did not count this as a gap, because the requirement does not define "selected" more precisely.

3. **An attempt advances the completed count only after its conversion finished or reported a collection failure.**
   - `fn[parallel_conversion_is_bounded_and_retains_every_result_in_order]` has the completion callback assert that `finished[index]` is already true.
   - The same test makes index 3 return `Err` and asserts that `completed == total`, so a failed conversion still advances the count.
   - It also asserts that every item is visited exactly once.
   - `fn[empty_conversion_starts_no_work_and_reports_no_completions]` covers the empty case. It is not marked for this requirement, but the empty case is already covered above.

4. **Child-process profiles are processed before an attempt completes, and the counts do not depend on test outcome.**
   - The pty test runs `test(child_process)` (success, 2 processes), `test(deliberate_failure)` (failed, 1 process) and `test(missing_profile)` (success, collection failure, 0 processes, with the diagnostic).
   - Each run checks the `1/1 attempts` display, that it is cleared, and the saved records.
   - `finish` passes `finish_attempt` as the whole-attempt work item and calls `progress.completed()` only from the completion callback.

I found no requirement-violating behavior that these tests would accept.

text: During report conversion, on a terminal enabled under
display updating progress with elapsed time and completed and total
test-attempt counts. The total MUST count the recorded attempts selected for
conversion. An attempt MUST advance the completed count only after its
conversion has finished or reported a collection failure, including processing
its associated child-process profiles. These counts MUST measure conversion
work regardless of the attempt's test outcome.
Habeas coverage progress MUST be displayed when stderr is an interactive
terminal and `TERM` is not `dumb`. `NO_COLOR` MUST disable color without
disabling progress. When stderr is redirected or `TERM=dumb`, Habeas coverage
progress MUST NOT emit animation or terminal control sequences.
Temporary progress displays MUST be cleared when their stage ends, including
empty work and early collection failures. Final diagnostics and the coverage
artifact location MUST remain readable. Progress reporting MUST NOT change
coverage results, retained profiles, or command exit status.
